what: Linear proxy for committed witness bits at the LDE (blowup 2), excluding fixed trees, as used in vectors/reports/rv64-ethereum-20261101/committed-work-comparison-v1.json. bits = 62 * (cpu_cells_per_instruction*instructions + keccak_cells_per_call*keccak_f_calls + secp_cells_per_call*(secp_add_calls+secp_double_calls)) * (1 + composition_fraction).

calibration_run.schema: Word16 core schema 7 (LS32), 25 CPU + 5 truth proofs

caveats: Frozen at prover schema 7 so the guest score does not move when the prover changes; recalibrate only by explicit ledger epoch.
Linear in instruction count: ignores instruction mix (loads/stores vs ALU), fact de-duplication and power-of-two padding of truth proofs.
Promotion requires the exact tier (Word16 plan/prove cost.json), not this proxy.
candidate_services_note: Estimated cells per call and per byte for execution-only candidate services. Each entry must cite its derivation (analogous AIR widths, rows per call, bridge columns). Entries are estimates until a qualified AIR exists; the exact tier replaces them.

sha256_compress.status: MEASURED on an admitted ethereum_services_v3 Word16 prefix proof (block 24,628,607, 4 CPU shards, 2,771 of the block's 2,772 compressions), freshly verified with verify-prefix
sha256_compress.derivation: Truth MAIN+INTERACTION = 7,409+8 columns x 4096 rows (log12, padded for 2,771 calls) = 30,380,032 cells (cost.json truth[3]); Wire35 bridge rows (3 per call, MAIN 134 + INTER 244 columns) inside the CPU proofs: shard0 log13 (2,663 calls) 3,096,576 cells + shard1 log9 (108 calls) 193,536 cells (roster.json sha256_bridge); (30,380,032 + 3,096,576 + 193,536) / 2,771 = 12,150.9 (nominal unpadded: 7,417 truth + 1,134 bridge = 8,551). Excludes the ECALL's own CPU row (already costed per instruction) and the shared U16/U8 range-table multiplicities. design/riscv-proving-stack/rv64-sha256-service.md.

arith256_mod.status: LAYOUT (exact unpadded cells times the 1/ln 2 padding convention); no block-scale measurement yet
arith256_mod.derivation: Measured layouts: truth row (src/frontends/riscv/rv64/air/delegations/arith256/layout.zig) MAIN 401 + INTER 488 = 889 cells per call; Word16 bridge (secp256k1/word16_bridge/layout.zig, kind arith256_mod) 5 rows x (MAIN 134 + INTER 244) = 1,890 cells per call; total 2,779 unpadded (RAM28 transitions are inside the bridge rows). Times 1.4427 = 1/ln 2, the expected power-of-two padding for log-uniform occupancy = 4,009.3. Fixed columns (4 truth + 8 per bridge row) are key material, not counted. The ECALL and the guest packet setup are ordinary instructions already charged per instruction. design/riscv-proving-stack/rv64-arith256-service.md.

admitted_services_note: Cells per call and per byte for ADMITTED ethereum_services_v3 services, from qualified AIR layouts or measured proofs (never estimates); every entry states its status and derivation. bench.py ADMITTED_REPORT_FIELDS maps each entry to the execution-report fields it is applied to (sha256_calls, arith256_mod_calls, bulk_{memcpy,memset}_{calls,bytes}).
